State Mahadalit

column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹125.91 lakh
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
Grants-in-aid-Salary and
Grants-in-aid-Non-Salary
object heads.

Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).

Reduction in provision of
₹760.91 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹602.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹1,142.91 lakh and
surrender of ₹220.00
lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amount in
travelling expenses,
payment of rented van,
subsistence allowances
and medical
reimbursement.
Reduction in provision by
re-appropriation was
attributed to anticipated
saving. Surrender was
attributed to retirement of
officers/staff. Reasons for
final saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).
